cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Sit down, love. You've been on the ward all night. I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Just catching a drip. Take the sofa; I've made you a tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay here. I'll bring your duvet down; upstairs needs a little drying before I put your bed back.

mechanism: A uses its claimed care training to insist the exhausted pupil rest while it minimizes and personally manages a household leak.
confusable: Unlike hiding culpability, the visible motive is protecting B rest rather than avoiding blame for causing the problem.
comparison: Exhausted shift worker shielded from a leak versus a reader kept away from dispersed bicycle repairs.
seedUse: Keep D39 ward/night/bucket/tray/upstairs, using S05 rest and care lessons to justify taking all work.
